title: An Earnest Effort Of Lesser Importance

contact_edits.before: In a broader sense it doesn't. An Ideal Husband is the final entry in a Stratford week that was otherwise an unbroken -- and, in my experience, unprecedented -- series of triumphs: The Odyssey, A Delicate Balance, Pentecost. In that context it's a letdown. But the successes count for more than the disappointment, in quantity, quality, and in sheer variety. This regime is going out in glory. - In repertoire until Oct. 27. Call 1-800-567-1600 for tickets and information.
